verdict.rationale: Glama documents that developers can search its catalog and "inspect their capabilities," and its hosted no-login Inspector shows a server's available capabilities over Streamable HTTP or SSE. However, the Inspector does this by connecting to the endpoint, so it is not pre-connection catalog metadata. Per-server pages are documented only as showing pre-filled config blocks. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that listings expose per-tool input schemas, transport type, and hosting attributes before connecting, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect a listed server's tools, input schemas, transport, and hosting attributes before connecting to it

citations.quote: Search Glama's curated catalog of open-source servers and remote connectors, inspect their capabilities
Glama's hosted inspector connects to remote Streamable HTTP and SSE endpoints so you can inspect available capabilities and test requests interactively
each server page shows the exact JSON block to paste, pre-filled for Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and VS Code
